title: TRON configuration: sizing.yaml
description: Holds TRON-configured canonical base quantities, per DEC-OPEN-04's currently PROPOSED MVP quantity-ownership model: 'fixed canonical base quantity from TRON configuration.' DEC-OPEN-04 (whether canonical quantity originates upstream from FALCON or is determined by TRON sizing policy) remains an OPEN Product Authority decision — this schema is built to hold the proposed MVP's shape as directed by the WI-D work item, but 07-CONFIGURATION.md and 11-DECISIONS.md flag this as a proposed, not decided, quantity-ownership model. The 'sizing_mode' field is included specifically so a future Product Authority answer that changes the quantity-ownership model does not require silently overloading this same field with a different meaning; it names the mode this config's shape implements. Contract-owner of this file: WI-D (WO-TRON-D1).

instrument_name.description: Instrument identifier string, consistent with mapping.schema.json's canonical_instrument keys.

nonnegative_decimal_string.description: Exact non-negative decimal representation (HR-05). Never a binary float.

config_schema_version.description: Configuration schema major version for this file. Must equal "1". See 07-CONFIGURATION.md §2.

sizing_mode.description: Names the sizing model this file's shape implements. 'fixed_canonical_quantity' is the only mode currently defined, corresponding to DEC-OPEN-04's proposed MVP. This is a PROPOSED, not decided, quantity-ownership model. If Product Authority decides a different model (e.g. quantity supplied upstream by FALCON, or a dynamic/risk-based sizing model), this file's schema will require a new mode value or revision — declaring the mode explicitly here means that future change is additive/identifiable rather than an implicit reinterpretation of an unlabelled field.

base_quantities.description: Map keyed by canonical_instrument (as used upstream in falcon.trade_action.v1.instrument) to the fixed canonical base quantity TRON sizing supplies for that instrument, decimal-string per HR-05. This value flows into tron.trade_intent.v1.canonical_requested_quantity under DEC-OPEN-04's proposed model; it does not by itself decide DEC-OPEN-04 (see tron.trade_intent.v1's own DEC-OPEN-04 note in 05-CONTRACTS.md §5).

default_base_quantity.description: Fallback base quantity for a canonical instrument with no explicit entry in base_quantities. Absent means: an instrument without an explicit base_quantities entry has no configured sizing and is not eligible for OPEN sizing under this configuration.
